title: data/costs.json
description: Prices and renewal dates. Hand-maintained: no dump reports what an invoice says. The LIST of servers and domains is derived from data/servers.json, so this file only ever supplies the two facts a collector cannot see. Keys are vps:<server-id>, domain:<registrable-domain>, or any other id with a label.

currency.description: ISO 4217. One currency for the whole file; mixed currencies would need conversion this build step has no business doing.

label.description: Only needed for ids that are neither a known server nor a discovered domain.

provider.description: Who bills you. Hostinger, GoDaddy, Cloudflare.

amount.description: Per cycle, in the file's currency. null means not recorded, which renders as such rather than as zero.

cycle.description: Normalised to a monthly figure for the total.

renewsOn.description: Next renewal date. The panel sorts by this and counts down to it.
